Subtract 329 days from 1714-08-14.  
1714 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days in 1714 before Aug 14: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31 = 212 days.  
So Aug 14 is day 212+14 = 226 of the year.  
329 days earlier: 226 - 329 = -103 days from start of 1714.  
Go back into 1713 (which is not a leap year, 365 days).  
-103 + 365 = 262nd day of 1713.  
262nd day: Jan 31 (31) + Feb 28 (59) + Mar 31 (90) + Apr 30 (120) + May 31 (151) + Jun 30 (181) + Jul 31 (212) + Aug 31 (243). 262 - 243 = 19 days into September.  
So date is 1713-09-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1713-09-19
